summary.text: Peter Leishman is a Democratic state representative from Hillsborough 33 who is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
A longtime member of the House Finance Committee, he owns the Milford-Bennington Railroad Co.

paragraphs.text: Peter Leishman earned an A.A. from Unity College.
His career experience includes owning the Milford-Bennington Railroad Co.
He has served on the Milford Board of Selectmen, on the Peterborough Zoning Board, and with the Peterborough Lions Club.
Leishman served in the New Hampshire House from 1996 to 2002, representing Hillsborough 6 from 2006 to 2008 and Hillsborough 3 from 2008 to 2010, with his current tenure beginning in 2011.
He assumed his current seat representing Hillsborough 33 on December 7, 2022.
Ballotpedia lists him on the House Finance Committee and as chair of its Finance - Division I committee in 2023-2024.
